mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 with reversed direction.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their 12-month moving averages signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 12-month averages, or interaction effect is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over one month signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines >0.2pp in high unemployment regime, or effect size is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past month reflects robust manufacturing activity and supply chain strength, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1000 thousand units, it signals strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% year-over-year and stable federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS change <= 0%) indicates persistent inflation without adequate monetary tightening, eroding real corporate profits and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0% AND FEDFUNDS change <= 0%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY >3.0% and FEDFUNDS change <=0%, or interaction term is not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate between 1.5% and 3.0% annually), a positive quarterly GDP growth rate signals sustained economic momentum that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate >1.5% annually in late-cycle expansion, or effect size is not significant (p>0.05).
